description: Test peer class implementation for QuicSpdySession, providing accessors and mutators for internal session components and features related to HTTP/3, WebTransport, and QPACK streams.

classes.name: QuicSpdySessionPeer
classes.description: A test peer class providing access to internal components of QuicSpdySession for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetHeadersStream
methods.description: Returns the headers stream associated with the session, asserting that HTTP/3 is not used.

methods.name: SetHeadersStream
methods.description: Sets the headers stream for the session by replacing the existing one.

methods.name: GetSpdyFramer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the session's SPDY framer.

methods.name: SetMaxInboundHeaderListSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum size for inbound header list.

methods.name: WriteHeadersOnHeadersStream
methods.description: Writes headers on the headers stream with specified parameters.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingUnidirectionalStreamId
methods.description: Retrieves the next outgoing unidirectional stream ID.

methods.name: GetQpackDecoderSendStream
methods.description: Returns the QPACK decoder send stream.

methods.name: GetQpackEncoderSendStream
methods.description: Returns the QPACK encoder send stream.

methods.name: GetQpackDecoderReceiveStream
methods.description: Returns the QPACK decoder receive stream.

methods.name: GetQpackEncoderReceiveStream
methods.description: Returns the QPACK encoder receive stream.

methods.name: SetHttpDatagramSupport
methods.description: Sets the HTTP datagram support level for the session.

methods.name: LocalHttpDatagramSupport
methods.description: Returns the local HTTP datagram support level.

methods.name: EnableWebTransport
methods.description: Enables WebTransport support and sets HTTP datagram support accordingly.
